We counted five ducks on the pond.
The bell rings at five minutes to three.

easy.def: To make something work again.
examples: Dad will fix my bike.
She fixed the toy.
Can you fix this?

more.def: To repair something that is broken or not working.
examples: Dad fixed the leak under the sink.
She fixed the tear in her jacket.
The mechanic fixes cars at the shop.

easy.def: To make food or a drink.
examples: Mom fixes lunch.
I will fix a snack.
Dad fixed dinner.

more.def: To prepare food or a drink.
examples: Dad fixed pancakes for breakfast.
Can I fix you a cup of tea?
She fixed sandwiches for the picnic.

easy.def: Something that is fixed in place in a building.
examples: The light is a fixture.
The sink is a fixture.
A bathroom fixture.

more.def: Something that is fixed in place in a building, such as a light or a sink, or someone who is always in the same place.
examples: The light fixture in the hall needs a new bulb.
The sink is a fixture in the bathroom.
The old man was a fixture on the park bench.

easy.def: The bubbly sound of a drink.
examples: The soda has fizz.
I heard the fizz.
The fizz tickled my nose.

more.def: The bubbles and hissing sound in a fizzy drink.
examples: The fizz of the soda tickled my nose.
You can hear the fizz when you open the can.
The tablet made a loud fizz in the water.

easy.def: To make little bubbles and a hissing sound.
examples: The soda will fizz.
The tablet fizzed.
Soda fizzes.

more.def: To make small bubbles and a hissing sound.
examples: The soda fizzed when I poured it.
The tablet fizzed in the glass of water.
Baking soda and vinegar fizz together.
